style: Photorealistic high-detail isometric 3D military strategy game render: {subject}. The picture holds separate views of the same subject; keep every view exactly where it is, with the exact same shape, pose, size, proportions and 30-degree isometric camera angle. Enhance with realistic weathered matte painted steel, subtle panel bolts and scuffs, authentic fabric creases, stitched webbing and combat boot leather, dusty tracks and tires, crisp desert sunlight from the upper left and deep realistic ambient occlusion shadows. Modern realistic military miniature style. NO cartoon outlines, NO black ink lines, NO pixel art, NO ground, NO cast shadow, plain solid neutral grey studio background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no roundels, no markings, no insignia.
